title: Note close, delivered
summary: One close per note: “Replies can fall while every send still shows as delivered.”, the red System Audit button, the quiet Talk to the team and one plain destination.
story: The note ends at its layer (the story map's job for a note), and the line turns the note's argument into the reader's next step. The three notes' lines share no sentence shape.
